title: Delegation and Engram recovery decisions use durable per-attempt identities and receipts, not resident transcript scans
outcome: Delegation results, outputs, command evidence, card and parent links, follow-up promotion, turn boundaries, and Engram retry, begin, checkpoint and cause decisions read durable per-attempt identities or exact persisted lookups. A missing resident message body never counts as proof of absence.
acceptance: Each identified scan has a recorded disposition: durable per-attempt result/output/command evidence, stable delegation-card/link identity, promoted follow-up identity, global turn boundary, initialized/nonempty-session state, or typed Engram operation/grant/head checkpoint/begin/retry cause. Authoritative reads use those identities/receipts or bounded exact persisted lookups, never negative proof from a missing resident body.

Deterministic tests exercise >64 trailing records, idle trim/reload/restart, follow-up after prior successful output, missing parent card/bootstrap, removed queued prompt, and delayed checkpoint/publication. Required output/evidence and exact attempt boundary survive; stale attempts cannot supply results or replace card/parent identities; command/watcher coverage or omission is explicit, never silently complete. Watcher observations remain distinct from writer attribution.

Recovery/hold decisions preserve exact grant/head/source/revision fences, success/failure precedence, Stop/operator pause, prepared/possibly-sent operation ambiguity and existing retry budgets. Missing display cards do not clear a hold, invent a new authority or authorize duplicate dispatch. Use fake clock/barriers and exact persisted fixtures; no speculative incident-cause attribution or broader scheduler/retry policy. Source-level audit alone does not pass these criteria.
